title: Qualitative and quantitative analysis of student’s perceptions in the use of generative AI in educational environments

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative observation by students analyzing AI-generated video frames across different historical time periods (e.g., 1920s vs. 2000s) to evaluate the representation and inclusion of Black individuals.

Qualitative evaluation of whether generative AI models recognize and depict marginalized racial groups (e.g., Black people) belonging to higher socioeconomic classes in historically themed generated images.
